name: The Bog Witch Stole My Shoe
source:
A fatally wounded knight is waiting for their quiet end when a weird person comes across them and decides to keep them company (alongside frogs).

[From [url=https://temteno.itch.io/the-bog-witch-stole-my-shoe]Itch.io[/url]]
